theme.description: Soft clinical teal + neutral grays. Calm medical style, focusing on trust, clarity, and simplicity. Avoid startup marketing look. Avoid colorful gradients and flashy visuals.

headings.style: Clean, highly legible, friendly but professional

body.style: Clear, clinical, excellent readability for dense data

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. 1 section per screen (Step-by-step). Mobile-first. Max-width on desktop to prevent eye strain.
spacing_and_layout.container: max-w-2xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 md:px-8 py-8 md:py-12
spacing_and_layout.card: bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 md:p-10 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(28,37,34,0.04)] border border-[#D1DBD7]
spacing_and_layout.form_elements: min-h-[56px] for large tap targets, generous padding

buttons.primary: h-14 w-full rounded-2xl bg-[#4A7C6B] hover:bg-[#3A6355] text-white font-medium text-lg transition-colors flex items-center justify-center
buttons.secondary: h-14 w-full rounded-2xl bg-[#E8ECEB] hover:bg-[#D1DBD7] text-[#1C2522] font-medium text-lg transition-colors flex items-center justify-center
buttons.ghost: h-14 w-full rounded-2xl hover:bg-slate-50 text-[#4A5D56] font-medium text-lg transition-colors flex items-center justify-center

inputs.text: w-full min-h-[56px] rounded-xl border-[#D1DBD7] bg-[#F5F7F6] px-4 text-base focus:border-[#4A7C6B] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#4A7C6B] transition-shadow
inputs.textarea: w-full min-h-[120px] rounded-xl border-[#D1DBD7] bg-[#F5F7F6] p-4 text-base focus:border-[#4A7C6B] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#4A7C6B] transition-shadow resize-none
inputs.checkbox: h-6 w-6 rounded border-[#D1DBD7] text-[#4A7C6B] focus:ring-[#4A7C6B]

progress_bar.fill: h-full bg-[#4A7C6B] transition-all duration-500 ease-out rounded-full

motion.page_transition: framer-motion: initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}
motion.interaction: Subtle hover states on buttons. No bouncy or playful animations. Serious, calming motion.

images.usage: Use as a very subtle, low-opacity background element or hero image on the landing screen to set a calm, organic tone. Ensure it does not distract from text readability.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast against background. Minimum 4.5:1 for body text.
accessibility.tap_targets: Minimum 48px, preferred 56px for buttons and form fields.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="start-anamnesis-button"`)

pages_and_flow.name: Landing / Intro
pages_and_flow.description: Welcome screen. Title: 'Digital Anamnesis / Digitale Anamnese'. Language switcher (DE/EN) in header. Clear explanation of privacy (data stays on device). Prototype disclaimer. 'Start' button.

pages_and_flow.name: Profile Creation
pages_and_flow.description: Simple form to create or select a profile (Name, Date of Birth). Auto-save to localStorage.

pages_and_flow.name: Multi-Step Questionnaire
pages_and_flow.description: 8 sections. Sticky header with progress bar (e.g., 'Step 1 of 8'). Sections: 1. Personal Basics, 2. Current Complaints, 3. Allergies, 4. Medication, 5. Previous Illnesses, 6. Previous Operations, 7. Family History, 8. Lifestyle. One section per view.

pages_and_flow.name: Review Screen
pages_and_flow.description: Summary of all entered data before final submission. Read-only view with 'Edit' buttons for each section. Must clearly display all filled fields.

pages_and_flow.name: Final Summary
pages_and_flow.description: Thank you message. Buttons to 'Print/Save as PDF' (using window.print()) and 'Download JSON' (Blob export). Option to 'Start Over / Delete Data'.

implementation_notes.storage: Use localStorage for all data persistence. Implement a hook like `useLocalStorage`. No backend. Data must be structured logically in a JSON object.
implementation_notes.i18n: Implement a simple translation dictionary in a separate file (e.g., `i18n.js`) with complete DE and EN strings for all 8 sections and UI elements. Provide a React Context for easy access.
implementation_notes.tech_stack: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide React, standard HTML forms heavily styled via Tailwind. Use .js/.jsx extensions, not TypeScript.
